PDF.js 6.4.299

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/pdfjs-dist/-/pdfjs-dist-6.4.299.tgz
Official project: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
License: Apache-2.0; see LICENSE and bundled font/CMap notices.

This directory contains the unmodified display layer, worker, viewer component, images, CMaps, standard fonts and WASM support files. The site-specific interface lives in pdf-reader.html and static/js/pdf-reader.mjs. Source maps are omitted.
